documents: Athanasia is a genus of flowering plants in the daisy family. Species Athanasia is native to southern Africa. The name is derived from the Greek a-, 'without', and thanatos 'death', alluding to the persistent dry involucral bracts. Athanasia adenantha (Harv.)
